news.title: Axon Therapies closes $32M oversubscribed Series A and names Zoar Engelman CEO
news.excerpt: Axon Therapies raised $32 million in a Series A co-led by Earlybird Venture Capital and Santé Ventures, with participation from Deerfield Management, CD Capital and KOFA Healthcare. Proceeds fund two double-blinded randomized feasibility studies of its Satera Ablation System in HFpEF and HFrEF; co-founder Zoar Engelman was appointed CEO and the company opened a UK-based European headquarters.
